item.title: Silvana Lima On Sponsor Rejections Because of Sexuality and How the Olympics Saved Her
item.description: Surfer Silvana Lima discusses her time on the WSL Championship Tour, how sponsors rejected her because of sexual preference, and how the Olympics saved her.

item.title: Lost Hikers Stick Mountain Rescuers With Hotel Bill After Safe Return
item.description: A pair of lost hikers rewarded their rescuers' efforts by sticking them with a hotel bill and making off with two headlamps lent to them during the operation.

item.title: Kelly Slater Tears Apart Duranbah on a Twin Fin
item.description: Kelly Slater attempted to empty the ocean while surfing a session at Duranbah on a twin fin. Judging from the amount of spray, he came pretty close to doing it.

item.title: John John Florence Will Not Return to the Championship Tour in 2026
item.description: The league had previously announced back in November that John John Florence would be returning to the CT after taking a sabbatical for the 2025 season.

item.title: Vail Guests Trapped on Broken Ski Lift, Evacuated by Rope
item.description: Little Eagle, a beginner lift near the top of the Eagle Bahn Gondola at Vail, stopped working just before noon on Sunday, leaving 40 guests stuck onboard.

item.title: Brianna Cope Becomes First Person to Circumnavigate Kauai in Single Continuous Attempt
item.description: On Saturday, January 10, Brianna Cope attempted something that has never been done: to circumnavigate Kauai, running 77 miles and paddling 15.

item.title: Jamie O’Brien Is Leaving Pipeline (Well, Sort Of)
item.description: Jamie O'Brien grew up within spitting distance of Pipeline. When he got some cash, he bought a house that looked over it. They're moving away, but not far away.

item.title: Mountain Lion Seen Wandering San Francisco Streets Has Been Captured
item.description: A mountain lion has been captured after being spotted wandering around San Francisco.

item.title: Zack Flores Tests 3 of the Weirdest Surfboard Fins Ever
item.description: Zack Flores isn't a standard thruster kind of surfer. In this video, he thought it'd be fun to try out a freshly shaped board with a handful of different fins.

item.title: Why Surfing at Night Might Not Be as Clever As You Think It Is
item.description: We all want uncrowded surf. But this is why surfing at night, especially at premier breaks, might not be as clever you think it is.
